name: @tessera/worker
description: The Cloudflare Worker: serves the web client, creates games, and hosts each game room in a Durable Object.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply tessera --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler r2 bucket create tessera-archive >/dev/null 2>&1; wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply tessera --remote
scripts.watch: wrangler d1 migrations apply tessera --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
